source:
#GOLD#Psi#LAST#
Psi represents how much energy your mind can harness. Like matter, it can be neither created nor destroyed.
It regenerates naturally, though slowly, as you pull minute amounts of heat and kinetic energy from your surroundings.
To get meaningful amounts back in combat, you must absorb it through shields or various other talents.
Your capacity for storing energy is determined by your Willpower.
target:
#GOLD#灵能值#LAST#
灵能值反映你的意志力能够控制能量的大小。与物质一样，不能产生或者消灭。
通常会随着你从周围自发吸收到的少量的热能和动能而缓慢恢复。
如果需要在战斗时迅速大量恢复，需要通过护盾或者其他技能进行能量的大量吸收来达到。
灵能值储存的上限由意志决定。

source: You asked me to come, about the rod of recall?
target: 你叫我来，是为了回归之杖？

source: All sustainable talents you currently sustain, using them will de-activate them.
target: 当前所有你已经开启的持续技能，再次使用即取消其持续状态。

source: #GOLD#[you are now an Avatar of a Distant Sun]
The secrets of death lay open to you! You are to become a Lich upon your next death!
target: 死亡的秘密已经朝你打开了！你下一次死亡就会转生为巫妖！

source: Spiders? Eww, sorry, but he is probably dead now.
target: 蜘蛛？恶……抱歉，但他现在恐怕凶多吉少了。

target: #Target#旋转一圈，一层光明护盾在他周围形成！

source:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
target:

你必须去那里，找到这一切的源头。

deep_observation: 译文「长袍无风自动」与原文相反。原文 billow with intense winds 是强风吹鼓长袍，译文否定了风的存在；该 NPC 正是风暴系。证据：tome，game/modules/tome/data/zones/rak-shor-pride/npcs.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，L308 desc；同文件 L303 注释 Arch Zephyr, Vampiric Storm Lord，同实体 resolvers.talents 含 T_FEATHER_WIND、T_THUNDERSTORM。
source: The robes of this ancient vampire billow with intense winds. Bolts of lightning arc along its body. In its hand it holds a bow, electricity streaking across it.
surface_observation: 原文“billow with intense winds”描述长袍随强风鼓动，译文“无风自动”将有强风误译为无风。
target: 这只远古吸血鬼的长袍无风自动。闪电在他的周身环绕。他手里握着一把长弓，电弧在这把弓上流转。

source: #CRIMSON##Target# suffers from %s from #Source#, mitigating the blow!#LAST#.
target: #CRIMSON##Target# 承受了来自#Source#的 %s，降低了伤害！#LAST#。
通用 增加火焰抗性穿透

source:

#GOLD#负能量#LAST#

source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the Far East.
target:
传送门是可以在眨眼间将你传送出很远距离的工具。它们通常需要一件关键道具来激活。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
 这道门似乎通向远东。

deep_observation: 原文 sided with him to learn the Legacy of the Naloren prodigy 是目的关系：为习得名为 Legacy of the Naloren 的 prodigy（天赋）才与其结盟；译文「并了解过纳鲁精灵的传奇」改成并列的「了解」，丢掉 prodigy 且把天赋专名降格为普通名词「传奇」。证据：tome，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；game/modules/tome/data/talents/uber/str.lua L223-226 uberTalent name=Legacy of the Naloren，require special desc=Have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik；game/modules/tome/data/achievements/quests.lua L192 成就 id=SLASUL_DEAD_PRODIGY_LEARNT、L194 desc。
source: Killed Slasul even though you sided with him to learn the Legacy of the Naloren prodigy.
surface_observation: 原文“to learn the Legacy of the Naloren prodigy”指为学习名为 Legacy of the Naloren 的 prodigy 而站在他一边；译文“并了解过纳鲁精灵的传奇”误作了解故事，且丢失了结盟的目的关系。
target: 杀死萨拉苏尔，尽管你曾与他并肩作战并了解过纳鲁精灵的传奇。

source: The ones that I need to get before the other alchemists get them. Can't have some lesser hack sneaking into the Brotherhood.
target: 就是我必须赶在其他炼金术士得手前弄到的那些。绝不能让哪个不入流的庸才混进兄弟会。

source: This gigantic shield has a stone eye embedded in it.
target: 这个巨大的盾牌上嵌有一个石质的眼睛。

source: There is already a character with this name, do you want to overwrite it?
target: 已经有一个这个名称的角色了，你要覆盖这个角色吗？

source:
Gone? Wait, this face.. you are @playername@! We thought you died in the naga portal explosion!
Thanks to your courage the Gates of Morning still stand.
You should go there at once.
target:
离开了？等一下，这张脸……你是 @playername@！我们都以为你在娜迦传送门爆炸的时候死了！
因你的壮举，晨曦之门依然屹立不倒。
你应该马上去那里。

source: #WHITE#I see. I will be waiting... #YELLOW#But not for long.
target: #WHITE#我明白了。我会等你……#YELLOW#不过不会很久。

deep_observation: 两处与机制不符。一、漏译 next to you：须标记与自身相邻的不可通行地形（range=1，且取自身到目标连线的第一格并校验 block_move）；二、Crush 5 alchemist gems into dust 是碾碎消耗箭袋中的 5 块炼金宝石，译文「使用 5 块宝石的粉末」既丢掉「炼金」限定，又把消耗宝石说成使用现成粉末。证据：tome，game/modules/tome/data/talents/spells/stone-alchemy.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63：L156 range=1，L160-164 hasAlchemistWeapon 且 getNumber()<5 则提示 ready 5 alchemist gems in your quiver，L173-174 line 首格 checkEntity block_move，L180 for i=1,5 removeObject(QUIVER)，L186 info 原文。
source: Crush 5 alchemist gems into dust to mark impassable terrain next to you. You immediately enter it and appear on the other side of the obstacle, up to %d grids away.
surface_observation: 原文明确使用“5 alchemist gems”，并限定标记“next to you”的不可通行地形；译文“5 块宝石”“一块不可通过区域”遗漏了炼金宝石的种类限定和地形必须相邻的条件。
target:
使用 5 块宝石的粉末标记一块不可通过区域，你可以立即越过障碍物并出现在另一端。
		有效范围 %d 码。

deep_observation: Decrepitude（衰朽、衰弱）被译作「破碎」，原文无「破碎」义。该持续法术命中时施加的减益是降低目标造成的伤害，属衰弱而非碎裂。证据：tome，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；game/modules/tome/data/talents/spells/necrosis.lua L149 name=Spikes of Decrepitude、L172 setEffect(EFF_SPIKE_OF_DECREPITUDE, power=reduce)；game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/magical.lua L4856-4866 该 effect status=detrimental，long_desc 为 Damage reduced by %d%%，activate 设 inc_damage all=-power。
surface_observation: “Decrepitude”表达衰老、衰弱之意，译文“破碎尖刺”中的“破碎”改变了这一含义。

deep_observation: 漏译 hold a shield：原文是「持盾并挥动武器」，译文以「严阵以待」替代，盾牌信息完全丢失。另 in rusty but servicable condition（锈蚀但仍堪使用）被译作「锈迹斑斑却值得信赖」，servicable 是尚可使用而非可信赖。证据：tome，game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/skeleton.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，L103 name=skeleton warrior、L104 desc。
source: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
surface_observation: 原文“hold a shield and swing a weapon”明确描述持盾并挥动武器；译文“严阵以待，挥动武器”将持盾动作改成了戒备状态，遗漏盾牌信息。
target: 施展在这只骷髅身上的魔法已经足够强大，足以让它像还活着的时候那样严阵以待，挥动武器。它仍然穿着它原来的那件老盔甲，锈迹斑斑却值得信赖。

source: Blasts creatures in a radius 1 shockwave around your target for %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength).
target: 在目标周围制造半径 1 的冲击波，轰击范围内的生物，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 物理伤害（基于力量）。

source:
It's quiet down here. And dark... very dark. I suppose I should have brought a lantern. Our motto is to bring light into dark places, but I guess I should have thought about that in practical terms. I've cleared out pretty much all of this area, and there's not much left to explore beyond this last room.

This adventuring stuff is quite lonely, I must say. I guess keeping this journal helps a bit. I miss home a lot now. I miss... I miss Falia. Maybe I should have said something to her about how I feel... but I guess running away on an adventure seemed easier. Pah, how brave of me...

I'm not cut out for this paladin work. Here I am, alone in a horrible dark dungeon in an unknown land, without a single sound to keep me company beyond the scratchings of my own quill. Hmm, except for--
target:
这里真安静。一片黑暗……好黑啊。我应该带个灯笼来。我们的座右铭是给黑暗之地带来光明——看来我真该好好想想这句话的字面意思。这片区域差不多都被我清理干净了，只剩最后这个房间可以探索。

冒险可真是孤独。我想写日记确实让我好受了一些。我现在非常想家。我想……我想念法丽雅。也许我早就该告诉她自己的感受……但我想，逃出来冒险似乎容易得多。呸，我可真勇敢……

我根本不适合当圣骑士。如今我独自待在陌生土地上一座可怕的黑暗地牢里，除了自己鹅毛笔的沙沙声，连一点陪伴我的动静都没有。嗯，除了——

source: Summons three to six dust storms.
target: 召唤三到六个尘土风暴。

source: a note about undead poetry from the Master
target: 领主关于不死诗歌的笔记
